title: Bambi. Friends in the forest.
lines: It is spring in the big forest.
The sun shines through the leaves of the tall trees.
Squirrels, bunnies, birds, mice and owls.
They all live together in the forest.
One morning a little bird flies around.
A little prince has been born!
All the animals of the forest come to look.
On a soft bed of leaves lies a little fawn next to his mummy.
He has big brown eyes, long eyelashes and white spots on his back.
He is a little deer, and his name is Bambi.
A little grey bunny hops closer.
He has a white tail and long ears.
And do you know why he's called Thumper?
Because he always thumps his back foot on the ground!
His legs are still very wobbly.
He can't walk very well yet, can he?
And after a while he is standing.
Come on, Bambi, I'll teach you everything!
They hop together through the forest.
Thumper teaches Bambi to jump over a log.
Thumper also teaches Bambi to talk.
And then he sees a butterfly.
No, laughs Thumper, that's a butterfly.
And then, out of the flowers, a little black animal with a white stripe pokes up its head.
But he thinks it's so sweet that Bambi calls him Flower that from then on his name is Flower.
When he blushes, he goes all red.
And so Bambi and his friends have a lovely time in the forest.
They play in the grass, they hide behind the trees, and they smell the flowers.
The animals crawl into their burrows.
Bambi snuggles up close to his mummy.
After the rain the sun shines again, and everything sparkles.
Mummy takes Bambi to the big meadow.
She plays with him and he goes all shy.
Then a big, strong stag with enormous antlers comes.
He is the great prince of the forest.
He looks at Bambi for a moment.
The leaves turn red and orange and yellow.
Bambi sees snow for the first time.
He pokes his nose in it.
He takes a bite of snow.
Come and slide on the pond!
The pond is completely frozen into ice.
But his legs slide out in every direction.
There he lies, on his tummy, with his four legs spread out.
Thumper laughs so hard that he thumps his foot.
And Thumper pushes Bambi across the ice.
Flower sleeps in his burrow all winter.
And then it becomes spring again.
Thumper is big too, and so is Flower.
Bambi grows up and becomes the new prince of the forest.
And with his friends Thumper and Flower he lives happily ever after in the big, green forest.
